findings.claim: The parser differential is not closed: ANSI-C $'…' quotes and backslash-escaped flags defeat every classifier (git commit $'--no-verify', git reset \-\-hard, bash -lc $'git reset --hard' all classify as routine), and eval 'payload' is stripped as a multi-token quote rather than classified as the command it runs
findings.proof: Agent sends Bash: git commit $'--no-verify' -m x — the shell strips the ANSI-C quoting to the literal flag (proven: bash -c "printf '<%s>' \$'--no-verify'" yields argv <--no-verify>), but classifiedText leaves the $ in the text, the (?:^|\s) anchor never matches, and the gate prints 'routine command — proceeding'; the commit hooks are skipped. For the destructive spellings there is no downstream fence at all. Variable expansion ($v), command substitution $(…), and backticks remain beyond a quoting fix and are registered as the stated boundary.

findings.claim: The 'config-neutral' diff read is not config-neutral: -c color.ui=never does not override a repo-local color.diff=always (the diff-specific slot wins), and diff.external/textconv (unneutralized) blank or rewrite the cached diff — addedDiffLines extracts zero lines and a staged real key commits while the gate prints its binding success line
findings.proof: Clone with git config color.diff always: verified live — git -c color.ui=never -c diff.noprefix=false diff emits ESC-prefixed markers on every token the parser keys on (^diff --git, ^@@, startsWith('+')); running the shipped parser on that output yields 0 added lines; stagedScanRefusal over the laced secret line returns null while the clean spelling refuses. The adapter self-test feeds a synthetic clean fixture that structurally cannot exhibit the laced shape.

findings.claim: A single pipe is not a split point: 'git push --force-with-lease origin main | rm -rf apps/' is one segment, the lease head matches, and continue skips the entire segment including the mass delete — reopening the exact exemption class this repair claims closed (the self-test pins only the && spelling)

The sessionDenialsAt stamp is dropped on the persistence round-trip: loadState returns it never, and the pass path (which follows every refusal by deny-once) persists state without it — the next load resets the counter, denials repeat '#1', the same file re-asked after TTL produces a byte-identical denial, and the 4th-denial condensed form is effectively unreachable

The persistent-form bypass rule deadlocks the documented fresh-clone activation: 'git config core.hooksPath .githooks' is mandated by AGENTS.md, WIRING.md, and the doctor's own fix text, but the bypass class refuses it always with no retry path — under the ALL-Bash wiring this commit documents, the agent can never perform the activation the doctor demands

AGENTS' 'the push fence re-judges what slips past' overclaims for the content scan: stagedScanRefusal has exactly one production caller (the commit-msg gate); the fence audits citations and scope, never secret content — a --no-verify commit with a valid in-scope footer lands a real secret with nothing failing

The banner-miscount repair re-introduced banner miscounts: task-gate claims 9+10+5=24 while the array enumerates 29; task-coverage claims 9 scan while scanCases holds 8 — hand-maintained counts over arrays nothing asserts, in the very lines repaired for count drift

The sh-payload extractor is an interpreter allowlist: zsh -c, dash -c, and bash --login -c payloads are stripped as multi-token quotes instead of classified (only sh/ash/bash with short-flag clusters are recognized)
The doctor's battery check greps the whole committed package.json for the substring — a string in any non-executing field certifies GREEN; it should parse the JSON and test the selftest script itself

WIRING.md line 99 still points at 'the push fence (§7)' after the renumbering made §7 the intervention gate; the CI step name and the register's f8 closure carry no deferral caveat for the still-deferred rename
